name: 拼装挡路架
subject: Two-cell long waist-high barricade built from mismatched steel rail and old planks braced between two concrete blocks. Ground footprint two tiles long along descending-right axis, one tile deep, broad side toward lower-left. Vertical supports upright; braced and used, not neat ornamental fencing.
prompt: Create exactly ONE transparent game prop sprite. References 1/2 are fixed style: strong dark hand-drawn contours, broad painted light and shade masses, readable forms with some brush texture; do NOT copy their pedestal. Reference 3 and 5 are approved final furniture style and localized wear. Reference 4 is the floor projection: orthographic, camera elevation45°, ground axes +/-0.7071, vertical edges vertical, tile144x101.82. Plan ground footprint BEFORE illustration; bottom contact corners must follow the template. Small top-down 3/4 view, two clear faces. Full object, generous transparent margins, NO floor/platform/pedestal/text/cast shadow. Upper-left light, restrained worn teal/ochre/cream/charcoal palette, modern industrial salvage society with repair/reuse, not medieval treasure nor nuclear wasteland. Readable at actual 144px grid scale, shape detail not photographic noise. Keep the vertical size believable relative to a 1.7m person. One prop only, no surrounding room or floor, retain transparent spaces between legs.
